concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI requires GRN inference to use a *sliding‑window pseudotime* approach (Monocle3 or Slingshot) for defining windows. The plan instead defines windows directly from observed developmental ages (e.g., “Fetal 12‑16 w”, “Adult”) and only uses optional pseudotime *within* windows. This deviates from the mandated methodology and therefore violates Principle VI.
